backward_compat_traps.rule: CoreSight is the debug/trace architecture; JTAG and SWD are the wire transports it runs over.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating CoreSight as 'a kind of JTAG/SWD' confuses the architecture with its transport.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The DEVARCH register is present from CoreSight v3; older components are identified by CIDR/PIDR/DEVTYPE only.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming DEVARCH exists on every component breaks discovery of older parts.

backward_compat_traps.rule: STM port count, ETB/ETF depth, TPIU pin count, and CTM channel count are implementation-defined.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Hard-coding any of these to a single value is wrong.

fields.ic_name: ARM CoreSight On-Chip Debug and Trace Architecture
fields.spec_version: ARM CoreSight architecture (commonly referenced as CoreSight v1/v2/v3 in public material); DAP per ARM Debug Interface ADIv5/ADIv6
previous_versions: CoreSight v1 — original component architecture (ETM/ITM, ATB funnel/replicator, TPIU/ETB, DAP over ADIv5).
CoreSight v2 — refined component identification and added/extended trace and cross-trigger components.
post_adiv5_evolution_industry_note: CMSIS-DAP — Arm's open USB-to-SWD/JTAG probe reference firmware.

key_changes.summary: Refined the component identification scheme and extended the trace/cross-trigger components; broadened multi-core debug support.
Added the DEVARCH register (architecture identification) and modernised component discovery; aligned with ETMv4 and the CoreSight Trace Memory Controller (ETF/ETR).
Successor to ADIv5 for the Debug Access Port, extending the addressing of Access Ports and component register access.

fields.version_naming_history_note: ARM CoreSight is a proprietary Arm architecture that has evolved across generations (publicly referred to as CoreSight v1/v2/v3), with the Debug Access Port following the ARM Debug Interface ADIv5 then ADIv6. Successive generations refined component identification (adding DEVARCH in v3), aligned with newer trace components (ETMv4, the CoreSight Trace Memory Controller realizing ETF/ETR), and extended cross-trigger and multi-core debug. Exact version details and register layouts are in ARM proprietary documents.
